_README: Nasdaq's public quote API is keyless and, unlike Yahoo, does not rate-limit
this project. It only serves US listings, so anything held on a European
venue has to be mapped to a US line here.
'exact' means the same security, so the EUR return is identical once FX is
applied. 'proxy' means a DIFFERENT instrument tracking the same index — its
return is close but not the real one. Prefer replacing proxies with a real
feed for the European listings when one is available.
Nasdaq serves raw closes, not dividend-adjusted ones. Distributions are
applied separately from the broker statements; accumulating funds need no
adjustment because the price already is the total return.

22UA.DE.note: Same BioNTech ADR (US09075V1026), NASDAQ line instead of the Xetra one. Quoted in USD; the EUR return matches once FX is applied. Pays no dividend.

CIBR.L.note: PROXY. Held line is the First Trust Cybersecurity UCITS ETF (IE00BF16M727) on LSE; this is the US First Trust NASDAQ Cybersecurity ETF. Same index, different fund — fees and timing differ.

VWCE.DE.note: PROXY benchmark. Vanguard Total World (FTSE Global All Cap) standing in for VWCE (FTSE All-World). Distributing, so it needs dividend adjustment; VWCE accumulates and would not.

^GSPC.note: PROXY benchmark. SPY stands in for the S&P 500 index. Distributing.
